direction: query=current network i; candidate=initial network j
primary_endpoint: mean rank of true initial candidate at E20; smaller is better
null_test: 10000 bijective global permutations of candidate identity labels, independent within each dataset; do not shuffle individual distances
inferential_unit: complete network trajectory; no independent-weight or independent-pair tests
metric_selection: fixed before computation, no outcome-dependent tuning
initialization_shuffle_confounding: one run seed determines both initial weights and minibatch shuffle; identifies training lineage, not a causal separation of initialization and SGD order
primary_family: all controls exploratory; the point1 protocol is a reference only

control_plan.metrics: Frobenius and normalized Frobenius, W0/W1/total; absolute initial/current norm differences
control_plan.residual_quantiles: candidate-specific bottom/top25% residuals, same rule for all100pairs; diagnostic metric sensitivity, not causal ablation
control_plan.activity: query-only low/high hidden activity quartiles on fixed saved probe; masked cost and new Hungarian for every candidate; inactive counts saved
control_plan.forbidden_leakage: no true-parent-derived feature mask in blind retrieval

top1_ties: Fractional credit 1/m for a true candidate tied among m minima
rank_ties: Average ranks; exact numerical tie tolerance documented in inference_diagnostics.json
uncertainty: Paired delete-one-network row+column; chance-adjusted scores, then back-transform to full candidate-set scale
jackknife_boundary_warning: A perfect observed score can have zero jackknife variance; this is not population certainty
null_storage: all label permutations and null statistics saved for reconstruction
posthoc_reason: Uncalibrated initial-versus-final norm differences give identical candidate ordering when all trained norms exceed all initial norms; norm ranks test order retention separately.
norm_rank_jackknife: Ranks recalibrated on the remaining nine queries and candidates for each paired deletion, then retrieval reranked.
